author: coziidruid
content: thats a tapeworm yeah, they will move, wiggle if u see them fresh (i have. too much experience w tapeworms) you can get a pill that kills them at most pet supply places including walmarts

author: coziidruid
content: tapeworms r p easy to get rid of, sometimes they have a source (fleas or eating poop w tapeworms in it) that make them come back and its good to treat that in addition to the tapeworms

author: coziidruid
content: ^these have always worked for me in the past

author: coziidruid
content: ava might have gotten tapeworms from fleas (very common way for cats to get tapeworms, cats will eat infected fleas while grooming which will in turn infect the cat) so if u havent already checked her for fleas pls do so

author: coziidruid
content: for future reference: elanco cat tapeworm dewormer is an over the counter, easy to obtain way to remove tapeworms that works for small and large cats- no vet visit required. just give the cat the recommended dose and dump the litter in the litterbox. always watch for fleas and coprophagia as those r the most common ways for animals to get tapeworms
